title: Understanding the Pattern
text: To extract the servings and course type, we need to identify the correct pattern for each. The servings are enclosed in square brackets, and the course type follows the word 'Course:'.

title: Pattern for Servings
text: The servings are always numbers enclosed in square brackets. Think about how you can match numbers in a regular expression.

title: Pattern for Course Type
text: The course type is a single uppercase letter following 'Course:'. Consider how you can match a single uppercase letter in a regular expression.

title: Fill in the Blanks
text: Use the patterns you've identified to fill in the blanks in the regular expression.
